what_happened: Scene: layout/style 4, dark wood cabinets; green-handled knife (knife_9) in the drawer under the counter; board next to the toaster, plate with a chicken drumstick just right of it (meat 0.46 m from the board). Stage 0 was slow: 100-620 the arm went in and out above the open drawer (wrist view on the knife from 148, withdrew 248, hovered 348-548) without closing; 620-684 it came down on the handle with open fingers and pushed it (packet hold 669-681, lift 0.013, no close event); 720-790 it re-oriented until the knife ran along the gripper axis, closed at 795, lifted from 808 (0.40 m), and released it flat on the board at 961 (0.049 m from centre). Stage 0 complete 962 (median 486, p90 724). Stage 1 had 638 steps left (p90 478) but the policy never went for the meat: it raised the arm (wrist on the range hood 1000-1060), briefly looked down at the board and drawer (1080-1120), then turned the base around to the kitchen island behind it (1160) and drifted around the island and room until 1600. It never closed the gripper again and never came within 0.46 m of the drumstick.
causal_chain: stage 0 slowed by approach-retreat over the knife 100-795 (~700 steps) -> knife on board 962 (normal placement) -> with 638 steps left (more than the p90 of stage 1) the policy turned away from the plate to the island 1160 -> wandered until timeout; meat never touched
self_recovery: Stage 0: re-oriented after the open-finger push at 669-681 and grasped at 795 (worked). Stage 1: none.
official_criterion_notes: knife tilt_deg is 24.5 at the start and 30.6 at the end although the knife lies flat in the drawer and on the board; the tilt axis of this knife model is not its 'up' axis.

packet_facts: close 795 w=0.042 lifted knife; only close event in the episode

uncertain_about: Why it turned to the island: the plate was not in the wrist view after the knife placement; possibly the policy lost track of the plate's location.
